data.name: Sunset Boat Tour
data.headline: 2.5 hours • Private charters available • The best view of the sunset!
data.description:
#Come see an amazing sunset on the Gulf!

##About
Enjoy the golden hour on the boat enjoying the island views while the dolphins play. Before sunset, we'll beach the boat and enjoy our toes in the sand on a barrier island. Get your camera ready for the colors when the sun goes down.

Private sunset tours only from Easter (April 9th, 2023) to Thanksgiving, ticket-based shared tours available during the winter season starting Nov. 19th, 2023.

##Provided
- Cooler with ice
- Shelling bags
data.cancellation_notes:
- Full refund if canceled 48+ hours before the tour.
- Cancellation insurance is available for any tour or ticket.
- No refunds for cancellations within 48 hours or late arrivals.
- Partial refund if the tour ends early for weather or safety reasons.
- Rescheduled tours can be subject to a rescheduling fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
- Any canceled tours can be subject to a fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
